methodology.family_set: top 10 represented genealogical units by frozen CLDR-derived speaker exposure
methodology.family_weight: speaker_exposure_estimate normalized across the analyzed family set
methodology.within_family_support: unweighted share of distinct sampled languages attesting the target family
methodology.F_strict: sum(family exposure * strict within-family support) / total analyzed family exposure
methodology.F_soft: same population-weighted family aggregation using only pre-existing soft-merger fallbacks
methodology.why_hybrid: population determines how costly exclusion of a genealogical group is, while unweighted within-family support prevents one mega-language from representing an entire family
methodology.relation_to_P: P_attested remains the direct demographic-language exposure metric; F adds genealogical structure rather than replacing P
methodology.population_caveat: CLDR-derived estimates may include L1 and L2 and overlap; exposure totals are not unique-human population counts
methodology.sampling_caveat: within-family support is estimated from the frozen PHOIBLE/GlottoDelta sample and can be noisy for sparsely sampled families
